info.name: Mist Admins Sites Clients - Wan API

params.name: distinct
params.description: Field used to group this count response. enum: `hostname`, `ip`, `mac`, `mfg`, `type`

params.name: type
params.description: See [List Device Events Definitions](/#operations/listDeviceEventsDefinitions)

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

items.docs: Count WAN client events for a site, optionally grouped by the `distinct` field and filtered by event type and time range. Use [Count Org WAN Client Events](/#operations/countOrgWanClientEvents) to count WAN client events across the organization.

items.docs: Count WAN clients for a site, optionally grouped by the `distinct` field and filtered by time range. Use [Count Org WAN Clients](/#operations/countOrgWanClients) to count WAN clients across the organization.

params.name: type
params.description: See [List Device Events Definitions](/#operations/listDeviceEventsDefinitions)

params.name: mac
params.description: Partial / full Client MAC address. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `aabbcc*` and `*bbcc*` match `aabbccddeeff`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*bccddeeff`) are not supported

params.name: hostname
params.description: Partial / full Client hostname. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `everest*` and `*rest*` match `my-everest-client`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*everest`) are not supported

params.name: ip
params.description: Filter results by IP address

params.name: mfg
params.description: Filter results by manufacturer

params.name: nacrule_id
params.description: Filter results by NAC rule identifier

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: sort
params.description: On which field the list should be sorted, -prefix represents DESC order

params.name: search_after
params.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving subsequent pages of results. This value is automatically populated by Mist in the `next` URL from the previous response and should not be manually constructed.

items.docs: Search WAN client events for a site with filters for client identity, manufacturer, NAC rule, event type, and time range. Use [Search Org WAN Client Events](/#operations/searchOrgWanClientEvents) to search WAN client events across the organization.

params.name: hostname
params.description: Partial / full Client hostname. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `everest*` and `*rest*` match `my-everest-client`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*everest`) are not supported

params.name: ip
params.description: Partial / full Client IP address. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `10.100.10.*` and `*100.10.*` match `10.100.10.54`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*.54`) are not supported

params.name: ip_src
params.description: Filter results by source IP address

params.name: mac
params.description: Filter results by MAC address

params.name: mfg
params.description: Filter results by manufacturer

params.name: network
params.description: Partial / full Name of the network the client is/was connected to. Use `prefix*` for prefix search or `*substring*` for contains search (e.g. `my-corp*` and `*corp*` match `my-corp-network`). Suffix-only wildcards (e.g. `*corp`) are not supported

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: sort
params.description: On which field the list should be sorted, -prefix represents DESC order

params.name: search_after
params.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving subsequent pages of results. This value is automatically populated by Mist in the `next` URL from the previous response and should not be manually constructed.

items.docs: Search WAN clients for a site with filters for hostname, IP address, source IP, MAC address, manufacturer, network, and time range. Use [Search Org WAN Clients](/#operations/searchOrgWanClients) to search WAN clients across the organization.
